meta.title: About us
meta.description: Learn Scooli's story, the mission behind it, and meet the team building it for teachers.

hero.title: Scooli exists to give teachers their time back.
hero.description: We're taking the repetitive work out of lesson preparation and bringing together a community that often works alone — with the teacher always in control of the final result.

story.title: It started with the teachers around us.

chapters.title: What we saw
chapters.description: Teachers close to us reaching the end of the day with classes taught and meetings done — and still facing an evening of lesson plans, worksheets and tests. Evenings and weekends with family disappearing into work that repeats, week after week.

chapters.title: The question
chapters.description: We're two young engineers, Miguel and Pedro. When generative AI started showing what it could do, the question became obvious: why doesn't that time go back to the people who teach? The usual answer — "just use ChatGPT" — fell short: it returns chat answers, not the structured documents a teacher actually uses, and it knows nothing about how a teacher's year is organised.

chapters.title: Scooli
chapters.description: So we built Scooli, with AI doing the mechanical work and the teacher keeping the final decision. Today it lays out each class's lessons from the yearly plan and prepares every week in one click. The goal has stayed the same since day one — give time back to the people who teach. And to their families.

story.videoCaption: Scooli at work · a lesson plan taking shape

mission.title: Take the heaviest part of teaching off your plate
mission.description: AI should be practical, useful and respectful of the teacher's role. And the mission doesn't stop at automation: we want a community where teachers find a solid starting point and feel less alone in the work.

faq.question: What does Scooli do for teachers?
faq.answer: It lays out each class's lessons from the yearly plan and prepares each week's resources: lesson plans, worksheets, tests, quizzes and slide decks. It also adapts materials by level and turns documents the teacher already has into new ones.

faq.question: How is Scooli different from ChatGPT?
faq.answer: A chat gives you text you still have to copy, format and check. Scooli gives you structured documents in your template, linked to each class's calendar and ready to export to Word and PDF.

faq.question: Does Scooli follow what I've planned for the year?
faq.answer: Yes. Each lesson starts from the class's yearly plan, subject and grade you set, so the week follows your plan. Everything stays editable.

faq.question: Does Scooli replace the teacher?
faq.answer: No. Scooli prepares the starting point and takes away the repetitive work; the teacher reviews, adjusts and always decides what reaches the class.

faq.question: Can I use documents I already have?
faq.answer: Yes. You can upload your own materials and turn them into new worksheets, tests or adapted versions, instead of starting from scratch.

faq.question: How much does it cost?
faq.answer: There is a free plan with 20 credits a month and a Pro plan with no creation limits. Schools have an institutional plan, with central team management and a pilot before deciding.

intro.heading: Introduction
intro.paragraph: Scooli is a product of FICTIONAL CLOUD, LDA. ("FICTIONAL CLOUD", "we", "us" or "our"), the controller of your personal data. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose and protect your information when you use Scooli, in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

provided.heading: Data You Provide
items: Email address (when you sign up to receive notifications)
Contact information you choose to give us
Feedback and messages you send us

automatic.heading: Data Collected Automatically
items: Website usage data (pages visited, time spent)
Cookies and similar technologies

dataUse.heading: How We Use Your Data
dataUse.intro: We use your personal data for the following purposes:
items: Sending notifications about Scooli's launch and important updates
Improving and personalising your experience on our website
Answering your questions and support requests
Analysing website usage to improve our services
Complying with legal and regulatory obligations
Protecting our rights and preventing fraud

legalBasis.heading: Legal Basis for Processing
legalBasis.intro: We process your personal data on the following legal bases:

items.text: When you give us explicit consent to process your data
To improve our services and communicate with you
When necessary to comply with legal obligations

dataSharing.heading: Data Sharing
dataSharing.intro: We do not sell, rent or share your personal data with third parties for commercial purposes. We may share your data only in the following circumstances:
items: With service providers who help us run the website (e.g. email services)
When required by law or by the competent authorities
To protect our rights, property or safety
With your explicit consent

rights.heading: Your Rights
rights.intro: Under the GDPR, you have the following rights:

columnOne.text: Request copies of your personal data
Request that your data be deleted
Restrict the processing of your data

columnTwo.text: Transfer your data to another service
Object to the processing of your data

security.heading: Data Security
security.intro: We apply appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your personal data against:
items: Unauthorised or unlawful access
Accidental loss, destruction or damage
Unauthorised alteration, disclosure or processing
security.closing: We use SSL/TLS encryption to protect data in transit and store information on secure servers with restricted access.

retention.heading: Data Retention
retention.intro: We keep your personal data only for as long as needed for the purposes for which it was collected:
items: Subscription data: until you cancel your subscription or ask for it to be deleted
Contact data: up to 3 years after the last contact
Usage data: up to 2 years for analytics
Legal data: as required by law

contact.heading: Contact Us
contact.intro: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or want to exercise your rights, you can contact us at:
contact.closing: We will reply to your request within 30 days, as required by the GDPR.

header.title: Terms of Use
header.tagline: These Terms govern access to and use of the Scooli website and (when available) the Scooli app, including AI content generation and community features.

termsOfUse.disclaimer: This is an English translation provided for convenience. If it differs from the Portuguese version, the Portuguese version prevails.

section1.title: 1) Acceptance of the Terms
paragraphs: Scooli is a product of FICTIONAL CLOUD, LDA. ("FICTIONAL CLOUD" or "we"), which provides the service. These Terms are an agreement between you and FICTIONAL CLOUD, LDA.
By accessing or using Scooli, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, you must not use the service.
These Terms apply to the website, any beta versions and the Scooli app, as well as related features (for example, the community library).

section2.title: 2) The Service and Accounts
section2.intro: Scooli is an education technology product of FICTIONAL CLOUD, LDA. that helps teachers create and organise teaching resources.
items: You may need to create an account to access some features.
You must provide accurate information and keep your details up to date.
You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential and for any activity on your account.

section3.title: 3) Acceptable Use
items: Use the service for illegal, fraudulent or abusive purposes.
Upload, generate, share or request content that infringes the rights of others (e.g. copyright, privacy).
Try to bypass security limits, exploit vulnerabilities or interfere with the operation of the service.
Share personal data of students (or other minors) without a legal basis and the applicable consents.

section4.title: 4) User Content and the Community Library
section4.intro: If the service lets you upload or share resources, you are responsible for making sure you have the rights to do so.
items: By submitting content to community areas, you grant FICTIONAL CLOUD, LDA. a non-exclusive licence to host, reproduce and make that content available within Scooli.
We may moderate, remove or restrict content that breaches these Terms, the law or the community's quality and safety standards.

section5.title: 5) AI-Generated Content
section5.intro: Scooli may generate suggestions and materials using artificial intelligence. These results may contain inaccuracies.
items: You must review and validate all content before using it in class, assessments or official communications.
FICTIONAL CLOUD, LDA. does not guarantee the accuracy, curricular fit or absence of errors of generated content.

section6.title: 6) Credits, Pro Plan and Cancellations
section6.intro: Some features depend on each plan's credit limit.
items: The free plan includes 20 credits per month.
Prices, features and limits may be updated over time.
The Pro Plan's "unlimited" access is subject to the Fair Use Policy described in section 7.
section6.contactItem: To manage or cancel your subscription, contact us at <email>info@scooli.app</email>.

section7.title: 7) Fair Use Policy
section7.paragraph1: Scooli's Pro Plan offers unlimited content generation for the subscribing teacher's personal and professional use.
section7.paragraph2: To keep the platform stable and the service reliable for every user, we apply a Fair Use Policy. It exists to prevent abusive, automated or non-human use that puts the integrity of the system at risk.

abuseBox.heading: The following counts as abusive use:
items: Sharing login credentials with third parties;
Using scripts, bots or any form of automation to generate content in bulk;
Several people using the account at the same time;
Any other use that clearly exceeds the pattern of individual human use.

section7.paragraph3: If a user's usage clearly exceeds the average expected for individual human use over a 30-day period, FICTIONAL CLOUD, LDA. reserves the right to:
alphaItems: Temporarily adjust the processing speed or the AI model used;
Contact the user to confirm that the usage complies with these Terms;
Temporarily suspend access in extreme cases of technical abuse;
Terminate the subscription in case of repeated or serious breach, with a proportional refund of the unused amount.
section7.paragraph4: This policy will always be applied proportionately and, whenever possible, after contacting the user for clarification.

section8.title: 8) Intellectual Property, Liability and Governing Law
items: Scooli (including its brand, software and design) is owned by FICTIONAL CLOUD, LDA. and protected by intellectual property rights.
The service is provided "as is" and may be unavailable at times, especially during beta phases.
To the extent permitted by law, FICTIONAL CLOUD, LDA. is not liable for indirect or consequential losses arising from the use of the service.
These Terms are governed by Portuguese law, without prejudice to applicable mandatory rules.
section8.closingParagraph: For privacy and personal data, see the <privacyLink>Privacy Policy</privacyLink>.

section9.title: 9) Contact
section9.paragraph: For questions about these Terms, contact us at <email>info@scooli.app</email>.

problem.title: Lesson preparation is every teacher's invisible job.
paragraphs: Lesson plans, worksheets, tests, slide decks: every week, for every class, mostly outside working hours and rarely building on what was already done.

AI chats help with writing, but they don't know the class, the curriculum or what has already been taught. Teachers still explain, copy, format and check everything by hand, one conversation at a time.

next.title: From a prepared week to a class Scooli knows.
next.description: Next, Scooli will remember each class: what has been taught, what has stuck and what comes next, so it can prepare the right lesson at the right time. That per-class memory is in development.
